how_to_read.states: ["All"] means every state. Otherwise a list such as ["Haryana"].
how_to_read.min_age / max_age: Age limits in years. null means no limit.
how_to_read.max_annual_income: Highest allowed annual family income in rupees. null means no limit.
how_to_read.needs_disability: true only for schemes meant for persons with disability. Missing means false.
how_to_read.rule_notes: Conditions that cannot be checked automatically. These make the status 'Needs confirmation'.
how_to_read.source: myscheme = page loaded with Playwright, startup_india = Startup India page, pdf = local PDF in data/.
how_to_read.verified: false until a team member has checked every rule value against the official page.
how_to_read.aliases: Other names people use for the scheme. Used to spot the scheme when a user names it.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.rule_notes: Cultivable land must be in the family's name. Income tax payers, government employees and registered professionals are excluded.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.rule_notes: For farmers (including sharecroppers and tenant farmers) growing notified crops in notified areas.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.rule_notes: Borrowers above 60 years need a co-borrower.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.rule_notes: Must have a savings bank account and must not be an income tax payer.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
schemes.rule_notes: Monthly income up to Rs 15,000. Must not be a member of EPF, ESIC or NPS, and must not be an income tax payer.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
schemes.rule_notes: Must have a bank or post office savings account.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
schemes.rule_notes: Must have severe or multiple disability (80% or more) and belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household.

schemes.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
schemes.rule_notes: For students who passed Class 8 with the required marks and study in a government, government-aided or local body school.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
schemes.rule_notes: Education loan for students admitted to listed quality higher education institutions. Interest subvention depends on family income.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.rule_notes: Loan is for a non-farm, income-generating micro or small business.

schemes.name: Stand-Up India
schemes.rule_notes: Applicant must be an SC/ST person and/or a woman, setting up a new (greenfield) enterprise.

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.rule_notes: Must hold a vending certificate or ID card, or a letter of recommendation from the urban local body.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
schemes.rule_notes: Adult woman from a poor household with no existing LPG connection in the household.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
schemes.rule_notes: For rural households that are houseless or live in a kutcha or dilapidated house, selected through the government survey list.

schemes.name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS)
schemes.ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
schemes.rule_notes: Startup must be recognised by DPIIT. Loans are given through member banks and financial institutions.

schemes.name: Playbook of Government Schemes and Initiatives for Startups (June 2026)
schemes.rule_notes: This is a guide covering many startup schemes, not a single scheme. Check the rules of the specific scheme mentioned.
